8881.description: 59 g catalog set-weight used as an empty-box estimate, plus six 23 g alkaline AA cells. Not a measured assembled weight.

8884.description: 24 g catalog set-weight used as a conservative receiver estimate; cable mass is included approximately, but flexible cable geometry and forces are not modeled.

notes: Catalog package dimensions are not treated as component dimensions. Bounds come from the local LDraw geometry at 0.4 mm/LDU.
Centers of mass and uniform-box component inertias are estimates. Replace masses/centers with measured values in a separate profile; its content hash identifies a different evaluation protocol.
Wired means ideal external power/control, no onboard electronics payload. Tether drag and electrical torque-speed behavior are not modeled.
